html.Envie apenas áudios, timbres e descriçõe: Upload only audio, presets, and descriptions you have the right to share. Do not post illegal content, threats, harassment, discrimination, spam, malicious files, credentials, or other people's personal data without permission. Do not impersonate anyone.
html.Você mantém os direitos sobre suas criaç: You retain the rights to your creations. By posting, you allow nichodev.com to store, display, and play the content to operate the community. Public presets can be tried and copied using the site's tools. Uploading audio does not grant other users a general license to redistribute your music. Make versions only when you have permission to use the material.
html.Privado fica restrito ao autor e à admin: Private content is restricted to its author and authorized administrators. Unlisted links can be forwarded. Public content must be approved before it appears in the gallery. Editing a public creation removes its approval and sends it back for review. Generating a new link or editing the creation invalidates the previous unlisted link.
html.A administração analisa publicações ante: Administrators review posts before they appear publicly and may hide content that violates these rules, copyright, or privacy. Approval does not certify copyright or guarantee technical quality. Review times are not guaranteed. To appeal or report a post, send its URL or ID, your reason, and a way to reply to
html.. Não inclua senhas, chaves nem cópias d: . Keep passwords, keys, and unnecessary document copies out of your message. Unauthorized access and data exposure receive priority.
html.Contas conectadas podem denunciar public: Signed-in accounts can use REPORT POST to report approved public posts by other accounts. The reasons for decisions appear in My Studio notifications. Moderators can hide or approve content, or reopen a review. Staff can block new posts for up to 30 days or suspend accounts for abuse. Decisions and reviews are logged. To appeal, use the contact above with the creation ID and your reason. Reporting alone does not hide a post.
html.Os limites iniciais, ajustáveis pela adm: Initial limits allow up to 100 creations and 50 MB of audio per account. Administrators can adjust those limits while preserving existing uploads. Each WAV may be up to 120 seconds and 10 MB. This environment starts with a 500 MB audio limit, and uploads may pause when it is reached. Maintenance or abuse prevention may interrupt access. Keep personal copies of your files as backups.
html.para saber como os dados são tratados e: to learn how we handle data and how to request deletion.
html.Use arte própria no NICO//CHAR. Não publ: Use your own art in NICO//CHAR. Do not post hate symbols, explicit nudity, personal data, credentials, or copies of characters without permission. Freehand drawings and comments are reviewed before they appear publicly. Report characters from their profiles, or contact moderation about a comment with its text and creation ID. Decisions include a reason and a notification in My Studio. Appeals can be sent to development@nichodev.com. Items and achievements are cosmetic.
html.A administração do nichodev.com é respon: The nichodev.com administration is responsible for the community. For questions, requests to access, correct, or delete data, or appeals about a post, contact
html.. Não envie sua senha nem sua chave de r: . Keep your password and recovery key private. Requests are free. We may ask for the minimum information needed to confirm account ownership.
html.A conta usa um nome de usuário, senha pr: An account uses a username, a hashed password, a hashed recovery key, and a registration date. A legal name and email address are optional. We store sessions, palettes, favorites, presets, descriptions, and audio you submit to provide the features you choose. Passwords and keys cannot be retrieved. Temporary request limits use an identifier derived from the IP address and account to reduce abuse.
html.As ferramentas processam o áudio localme: The tools process audio locally in your browser. The community receives the files and settings you choose to submit. Feedback may include an optional comment and contact details. We use it to investigate issues and respond to you. Feedback is not published automatically.
html.Criações começam privadas. O autor e adm: Creations start private. Their authors and authorized administrators can access private content to operate and moderate the service. Public content requires approval. Anyone who receives an unlisted link can forward it. Remove any personal information you want to keep private before posting.
html.O backend e os arquivos ficam na Hosting: Hostinger hosts the backend and files. Encrypted backups are stored in Cloudflare R2. These providers process data to host and protect the service and may use infrastructure outside Brazil. Their own handling of data follows their policies:
html.As ferramentas podem carregar biblioteca: The tools may load libraries and fonts from Google Fonts, cdnjs, jsDelivr, and unpkg. Loading these resources sends technical information such as your IP address to the provider. We use no advertising or external behavioral trackers. Our operational metrics use daily activity and aggregate counts only. We use an essential sign-in cookie and local storage for preferences and drafts. Guest palettes stay in the browser.
html.No cadastro e na troca de senha, consult: During registration and password changes, we use the Have I Been Pwned Pwned Passwords service to reject compromised passwords. The server sends only the first five characters of a password hash over HTTPS. Your password, username, recovery key, and full hash are kept private. This check is skipped at login. See the
html.Sessões duram até sete dias, cadastros n: Sessions last up to seven days, unconfirmed registrations expire after 30 minutes, feedback is removed after 90 days, and uploaded audio without an associated creation is removed after 24 hours. Temporary rate limits expire according to their protection windows. Accounts and creations remain while you keep them. Account settings let you export your data or delete your account by confirming your username and password. Deletion removes sessions, palettes, favorites, creations, and audio from the active database. A sole administrator must appoint a replacement before deleting their account.
html.Os dados excluídos podem permanecer em b: Deleted data may remain in isolated backups configured for 30-day retention, subject to the provider's expiration cycle. These backups are reserved for recovery. After disaster recovery, deletion requests must be reapplied before reopening the service. Anonymous feedback is not automatically linked to an account. To request removal, contact us with enough information to identify it.
html.Registramos ações administrativas e seus: We log administrative actions and their reasons for up to 365 days. The history may retain the username and ID of the administrator and affected account after deletion for accountability. Moderation decisions are kept for 365 days, reports for 180, notifications and daily activity for 90, and assisted recovery requests for 30. Cleanup runs periodically. Recent activity is rounded to the hour. Daily metrics count account activity per day and keep no page history. Reported preset uses are aggregated per creation and day for 90 days. Phased rollout assigns a stable group by hashing account IDs, with no behavioral profiling.
html.Equipe administrativa utiliza segundo fa: Administrators use two-factor authentication. Authenticator secrets are encrypted in the private database and emergency codes are hashed. Assisted recovery verifies your key on the server, requires approval and a private single-use token, and keeps previous passwords hidden from administrators. Recovery requires existing proof of ownership. Keep recovery keys and tokens out of email. Suspension blocks login and revokes sessions while preserving the account data. Decision notices appear in My Studio.
html.Guardamos na sua conta as peças, nome, m: We store your character's parts, name, mood, palette, scene, mini studio, pixel art, cosmetic achievements, and version in your account. Public characters appear beside your username on profiles, member listings, creations, and comments. You can hide yours and return to the default look. Freehand drawings stay private until approved, and the last approved version stays visible. Comments are also reviewed. Staff can review or hide content with a reason, notification, and audit record.
html.Conquistas registram apenas o marco alca: Achievements record milestones only, with no rankings, access advantages, or browsing history. The exploration achievement records a reported tool opening without verifying use or audio. Streaks use the existing daily activity record. Character reports are retained for up to 180 days. Characters, achievements, and comments remain until you delete the account or content. Account exports include them. PNG and GIF files are generated in your browser and stay outside the private backup bucket.
html.Você pode editar ou excluir criações, mu: You can edit or delete creations, change their visibility, revoke unlisted links, change your password, replace your recovery key, and delete your account. Your data export includes account data and private audio links. Download the WAV files while signed in. For other data requests, contact us. You can also read the
